headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when FTR & PAC wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 8.01 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle.
Looking back to 2022, when Anderson, Dante & Moriarty arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14.

On this day in 2024, Castagnoli & Danielson vs. Fletcher & Takeshita fought it out in a Bunkhouse Tag match on Collision, rated 8.04 ? one of the better matches of the year in a hard-hitting tag team clash.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, AEW welcomed Briscoe, Copeland & Kingston for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.76.
Rewind to 2022, when Danielle Kamela laced up for their first AEW match against Britt Baker, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.36.
That Wednesday in 2022, Darby Allin vs. Andrade El Idolo fought it out in a Coffin Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 5.70 in a hard-fought men's division clash.
